extracted.name: Chipotle chicken & slaw
extracted.description: Enjoy our hot and spicy chicken drumsticks with homemade slaw on the side for a healthy and low calorie supper. Serve with steamed corn on the cob
ingredient_lines: 125g each red and white cabbage both shredded
4 corn on the cobs steamed, to serve (optional)
instruction_lines: Heat the oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Whisk the oil, chipotle paste and honey together in a large bowl. Add the chicken and toss to coat, then spread out on a non-stick baking tray. Roast for 30 mins, turning halfway through.

Put the lime zest and juice, avocado flesh, yogurt and a good pinch of salt into a blender and blitz until completely smooth. Put the sauce in a large bowl with the cabbage, carrot and spring onion and toss to combine.
Serve the drumsticks with the slaw and steamed corn, if you like.
